## Install

1. Download **Cellar.dmg** below (Apple silicon and Intel), open it, and drag Cellar into Applications.
2. Open Cellar. Cellar isn't signed with a paid Apple developer account yet, so the first time macOS says it can't verify it:
   - Click **Done**.
   - Go to **System Settings › Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**, then confirm.
3. If macOS offers to install its free Command Line Tools, accept. Cellar runs on the Python that comes with them.
4. On the phone: Settings › About phone › tap **Build number** 7 times, then Developer options › **USB debugging**. Plug in and tap **Allow**.

Prefer no warnings at all? Clone the repository and double-click **Build Mac App.command**; a copy built on your Mac opens straight away.

`Cellar.dmg.sha256` holds the SHA-256 checksum of the download.
